_: Gates excused from gates_of_heck's empty-scope rule. TWO sections on purpose: `legitimate` is a gate that SHOULD pass over an empty tree and always will; `known_blind` is a defect with a name on it, awaiting a guard, and may only ever SHRINK. Collapsing them is how a burn-down list becomes permanent permission.

legitimate._: TWO entries are not a burn-down list. `check_built_binaries.py` is here because its subject is build output and a fresh clone genuinely has none (2026-10-14, after the ratchet test below demanded this section be empty and the gate proved the case was real: CI builds only what a job needs, so a hard failure there fires the gate on the absence of a problem). `known_blind` is the section that may only shrink.
legitimate.check_built_binaries.py: Its subject is build OUTPUT (target/), which no checkout carries: a fresh clone, a pre-push export before its cargo steps, and goh's empty-scope skeleton all legitimately have nothing built, and the gate says so ('nothing built to check'). This is the section's own case -- a gate that SHOULD pass over an empty tree and always will -- not an excuse for a blind gate, which is what `known_blind` is for. Where it has a subject it is run after one is made: last in GOH_CI_STEPS, after the cargo build/test steps, and after the build in both CI jobs, and CI builds only what a job needs, so failing here would fire the gate on the absence of a problem (tests/test_binary_resolver.py pins the skip). It judges its OWN tree's target/ (2026-10-14); before that it read the editable-installed divoom_client's checkout, so over a skeleton it reported on the main checkout's binaries -- which is the host-dependence the ratchet test was written to catch, and which the judges-its-own-tree change removed.

known_blind._: EMPTY, and it should stay that way. The six gates listed here on 2026-09-07 were all fixed the same day with tools/_empty_scope.py rather than excused: check_file_size, check_gui_is_a_client, check_no_allow, check_positional_args, check_scripts, and check_applescript_launch. Use the shared helper; do not add an entry here to make a red run green.
